title: almagestd protected config
description: Protected HuJSON/JSON configuration file for ./bin/almagestd. These options are read at startup and should not be editable through the admin API.

Web.description: Local web admin port bound on 127.0.0.1. 0 disables the web admin listener. Command-line --web / ALMAGEST_WEB_ADMIN overrides this value.

Unix.description: Unix-domain socket path for the stream admin API on platforms that support Unix sockets. Empty string disables the unix admin listener. Command-line --unix / ALMAGEST_UNIX_ADMIN overrides this value.

adminPeerFiltersConfig.description: Optional admin listener filters. When at least one rule is configured, the listener accepts only connections whose peer owner matches a UID, GID, or username rule. Web filters use gonnect/protected best-effort socket-owner lookup. Unix filters use OS peer credentials where implemented.

Usernames.description: Allowed peer owner usernames. Usernames are resolved by gonnect/protected when the listener is created and for each accepted connection.
